relations.subject: Theodor Goldstücker
relations.evidence: he entered its university in 1836 as a student of Sanskrit. In 1838 he removed to Bonn, and, after graduating at Königsberg in 1840, proceeded to Paris

relations.subject: Theodor Goldstücker
relations.evidence: In 1852 he was appointed professor of Sanskrit in University College London.

relations.subject: Theodor Goldstücker
relations.evidence: In 1850 he moved to London at the invitation of H. H. Wilson. [...] He worked on a new edition of Wilson's Sanskrit dictionary

relations.subject: Theodor Goldstücker
relations.evidence: He was the founder of the Sanskrit Text Society

relations.subject: Theodor Goldstücker
relations.evidence: he was also an active member of the Philological Society, of which he was president at the time of his death
